During a cheerful stretch, we welcome your detailed note; we looked into it and understand that your complaint concerns the care and handling of your companion animal during travel, along with the frustration and worry that followed.

We are sorry that Aurelia Skyways did not meet the standard of care you were entitled to expect. The Companion Animal Travel Desk treats each journey as a shared responsibility, and a welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs so that pets are handled with patience, cleanliness, and close attention. When a journey does not proceed as planned, we look first at the animal's wellbeing, then at the service breakdown, and then at how we can make the matter right with care and fairness. <<FACT F120>> We also note that delayed departure situations are reviewed under our normal customer care process. <<FACT F109>>

Your report has been forwarded for review of the handling records and the service notes from the trip. If any action fell short of our standards, we will address it directly and support the next steps with clear communication. We appreciate the trust you placed in us, and we remain committed to better travel experiences for every companion animal and the traveler responsible for them.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
